name: mods/alomare/flexible_stratagems
description: Bring the same stratagem more than once in the Hellpod loadout, vehicles included, ready up with fewer than four stratagems, keep the stratagem list open when you replace one, and empty all four slots with one key.
requires: Bingus Shared Loader v17 or newer
Mod Bindings Menu (optional: the Clear Stratagems key)

standard.description: Ready up with fewer than four stratagems in the Hellpod loadout, keep the stratagem list open when you replace one, and empty all four slots with one key.
